script_text:
Stop! Libra, your ruling planet is about to betray your peace.

Venus, your Air element ruler, is squaring aggressive Mars in your 10th House of Career and Public Image, creating a clash between charm and ambition. Meanwhile, Mercury in your 2nd House of Money sextiles disciplined Saturn, giving you a rare edge in financial negotiations.

In love, if you're partnered, expect a power struggle over who calls the shots—don't let career stress spill into the bedroom. If you're single, you'll attract someone bold and competitive, but they may prioritize work over romance.

Financially, this is the day to sign contracts or ask for that raise; your 10th House visibility is high, but your 2nd House money sector is protected by Saturn's structure.

Avoid sending heated emails to your boss before lunch—Mars square Venus makes you say things you can't unsay.

Follow for tomorrow's reading.
